metadata.description: MCP tools for LTspice/ngspice circuit simulation and LTspice .asc schematic editing in Claude Code. Structured results include per-device operating points (gm/gds/vth) by device name.

plugins.name: ltspice-mcp
plugins.description: MCP tools for LTspice/ngspice circuit simulation and LTspice .asc schematic editing. Structured results include per-device operating points (gm/gds/vth) by device name, without parsing raw files. Requires uv and a simulator (LTspice or ngspice) on the host; the server is fetched from PyPI via uvx on first use.
